title: Cinematic Post-Process Director Console
description: The user acts as a cinematic director controlling a battlefield scene where an animated soldier patrols around a pedestal of ShaderBall2 objects. A floating control panel lets the user layer and fine-tune multiple post-processing effects—bloom, depth of field, chromatic aberration, vignette, film grain, and color grading—to craft a dramatic cinematic look, with each effect validated against target parameter ranges.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 with EffectComposer from three/addons. Load soldier.glb (animated, use the 'Run' clip via AnimationMixer) and place it on a circular patrol path (radius 4) around the origin. Load ShaderBall2.glb and place 3 instances on pedestals (simple BoxGeometry) at the origin arranged in a triangle formation, each with a different metallic material tint (gold, chrome, obsidian). Use a PerspectiveCamera at position (0, 5, 12) looking at origin. Add a DirectionalLight casting shadows plus ambient light. Set up an EffectComposer with these passes chained: RenderPass, UnrealBloomPass, BokehPass (depth of field), and three custom ShaderPasses for chromatic aberration (RGB channel offset uniform), vignette (darkness and offset uniforms), and film grain (intensity and time uniforms). Also add a color grading ShaderPass with brightness, contrast, and saturation uniforms. Build an HTML/CSS overlay panel titled 'Director Console' with labeled sliders for: (1) Bloom threshold 0-1 default 0.8, (2) Bloom strength 0-3 default 0.5, (3) Bloom radius 0-1 default 0.4, (4) DoF focus distance 1-20 default 8, (5) DoF aperture 0-0.01 default 0.002, (6) Chromatic aberration offset 0-0.02 default 0, (7) Vignette darkness 0-2 default 1.2, (8) Film grain intensity 0-0.5 default 0, (9) Saturation 0-2 default 1, (10) Contrast 0.5-1.5 default 1. Each slider must update its corresponding pass uniform in real time. Add a 'Validate Cinematic Look' button that checks all parameters fall within these target ranges: bloom strength 1.0-2.5, bloom threshold 0.1-0.5, DoF aperture 0.003-0.008, chromatic aberration 0.005-0.015, vignette 1.0-1.8, grain 0.1-0.35, saturation 0.6-1.2, contrast 0.8-1.3. Display pass/fail per parameter with green/red indicators. Animate the soldier walking the patrol path each frame. Render at window size with antialiasing and toneMapping set to ACESFilmicToneMapping.
